subject: King Dodongo
text: Throwing a Bomb down King Dodongo's gullet when he inhales stuns him, allowing Link to slash his head with the sword.

evidence.quote: Basically avoid this boss until he starts to inhale. When he does, whip out a Bomb and throw it straight down his gullet. This'll stun him, so run up and slash his head with your sword.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo's rolling attack can be avoided by standing on the edge of the platform where it meets the lava.

evidence.quote: After a few slashes, he'll then roll into a ball and roll around the room. He can be easily avoided here by standing on the very edge of the platform where it meets the lava.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo can be defeated more quickly by jump striking with Deku Sticks and shield stabbing while he is stunned.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: Just jump strike with Deku Sticks and shield stab (hold R and press B repeatedly while not locked on) after he's stunned to defeat him more quickly.

subject: Barinade
text: Z-targeting Barinade's 3 tentacles and cutting them loose with the Boomerang makes the surrounding jellyfish spin.

evidence.quote: Z-target one of its tentacles and use the Boomerang to cut it loose. Do this for all 3 tentacles, and the jellyfish surrounding it will spin around.

subject: Barinade
text: Hitting Barinade's center with the Boomerang loosens its grip on its protective jellyfish, and stunning it reveals another layer of jellyfish around its weak spot.

evidence.quote: Boomerang its center to make it loose its grip on the jellyfish. Destroy all these jelly fish, and doing so makes it rise to reveal some more jellyfish, this time surrounding its weak spot. Keep on using the Boomerang until you stun it, then kill all these other jellyfish.

subject: Barinade
text: Once Barinade's jellyfish defenses are gone, stun its center with the Boomerang to slash it, being mindful that it fires electric beams faster as it takes damage.

evidence.quote: Stun its center with the Boomerang, then move in and slash it. It'll take a few tries, and it unleashes electric beams more rapidly as it's damaged. Keep stunning and slashing until it's dead.

subject: Barinade
text: Stunning Barinade after eliminating all jellyfish and performing shield stabs kills it more quickly.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: After getting rid of all its protective jellyfish, stun it and simply use the shield stab attack to kill it more quickly.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Shoot an arrow at Phantom Ganon when purple magic surrounds him as he escapes from a painting.

evidence.quote: Basically what you have to do, is aim your arrow at the Phantom when he escapes from the painting. (purple magic surrounds him when he's about to exit)

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Failing to shoot the real Phantom Ganon when he emerges from a painting results in a lightning attack that takes away at least five hearts.

evidence.quote: The fake one turns around, so if you encounter that one, hurry up and find the real one and fire that arrow. If you don't, you'll be struck with a lightning attack that takes away at least five hearts.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Swinging the Master Sword reflects Phantom Ganon's magic spell back at him, stunning him on the floor so he can be slashed.

evidence.quote: Use the Master Sword and swing it at the right time to reflect the magic spell back at Phantom Ganon. He'll usually reflect it back, so continue this tennis game until it hits either one of you. If it hits Phantom Ganon he'll go to the floor, stunned. So go up to him and slash him.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Deflecting Phantom Ganon's magic point-blank immediately hits him, allowing Link to shield stab him while he is grounded.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: After getting rid of its stallion, get really close to Phantom Ganon, and time your slash right so that it's deflected as soon as it fires its magic ball attack...Once it reaches the ground, shield stab the phantom until it's dead.

subject: Volvagia
text: Avoiding Volvagia's fiery hair attack and pounding her head with the Hammer causes her to retreat.

evidence.quote: Wait for Volvagia to reveal its head, and when it does, it will throw its fiery hair to try to attack you...Stay away from her(?) hair attack, and go up to her and pound her head down with the Hammer.

subject: Volvagia
text: As Volvagia takes damage, fire erupts from one hole as a trick before she emerges from a different hole.

evidence.quote: As you damage her, she'll try to trick you by having fire come up where she should appear, but then she appears in another hole.

subject: Volvagia
text: Hanging from the edge of the platform when Volvagia flies causes her to immediately retreat underground.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: When she starts flying around, drop down the sides slowly and you'll grab onto the sides as if its a grate or vine, or something. Doing this will make her lose her interest in attacking you and will go back underground immediately.

subject: Morpha
text: Getting grabbed by Morpha inflicts three hearts of damage.

evidence.quote: It'll throw itself towards you, and if it grabs you, you'll suffer three hearts of damage.

subject: Morpha
text: Morpha can form bodies even while its brain is exposed and will eventually spawn two bodies simultaneously.

evidence.quote: As you damage it, it'll form its body even when the brain is outside of it...It'll even still form two bodies at once.

subject: Morpha
text: Using the Longshot between slashes prevents Morpha's brain from escaping.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: To keep the brain from escaping while you're attacking it, Longshot between slashes and you should take care of it more quickly.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Shooting Bongo Bongo's hands with arrows prompts a ramming attack, allowing Link to see him with the Lens of Truth and stun his eye with an arrow.

evidence.quote: First of all, you have to arrow its hands. Do so, and the boss will try to ram you. Use the Lens of Truth to see him, and put an arrow into his eye. This'll stun him, so go up to him and slash him until he's dead.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: The Biggoron's Sword works best for slashing Bongo Bongo when he is stunned.

evidence.quote: The Biggoron's Sword works best.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Using the Biggoron's Sword with the shield stab technique is optimal when Bongo Bongo is stunned.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: The Biggoron's Sword with the shield stab technique is your best friend when he's stunned.

subject: Twinrova
text: Reflecting an elemental beam with the Mirror Shield toward the witch of the opposite element damages her.

evidence.quote: One fires a powerful ice beam, the other fires a powerful fire beam. In order to damage these witches, you must reflect their spells with the Mirror Shield and point it toward the other witch.

subject: Twinrova
text: Locking on with Z or L and then releasing targeting aligns Link directly with the witch firing the beam.

evidence.quote: If you're having trouble facing the boss that fires the beam, Z (or L) target the boss then break out of lock-on. That way you'll be perfectly facing the boss. Each witch needs to take a few hits before the next phase begins.

subject: Twinrova
text: Absorbing three projectiles of the same element with the Mirror Shield fires a beam that stuns merged Twinrova.

evidence.quote: You must absorb three projectiles OF THE SAME ELEMENT. If you absorb two fires and one ice, it'll cancel out and you'll have to try again...Once you do, you'll fire a beam of that element, stunning her. Now's your chance. Rush to her and start slashing her repeatedly.

subject: Twinrova
text: Running toward Twinrova while absorbing the third projectile enables an immediate Biggoron's Sword shield stab upon stunning her.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: Since reflecting the beams and absorbing the projectiles are random or hard to speed up, when you absorb the last projectile needed to stun her, run toward her as you absorb the projectile, and as soon as she's stunned, break your lock, get out the Biggoron's Sword as you jump over, and shield stab her.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Rolling to the outer rim when Ganondorf pounds the ground prevents Link from falling down.

evidence.quote: The boss starts out by pounding the ground. Quickly roll away to the outer rim so you won't fall down.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Ganondorf's magic spells can be reflected back at him using sword swipes or Empty Bottles.

evidence.quote: Just like Phantom Ganon, Ganondorf throws magic spells that you have to reflect back at him with sword swipes. (Or oddly enough, Empty Bottles)

subject: Ganondorf
text: Using an Advanced Spin Slash deflects Ganondorf's simultaneous multi-magic projectile barrage.

evidence.quote: When you see both his arms raised and energy gathers toward him, he'll fire multiple magic spells at you simultaneously. In order to deflect those, use the Advanced Spin Slash.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Shooting Ganondorf with a Light Arrow in the face while he charges his multiple magic attack interrupts him and saves magic.

evidence.quote: Another thing to do is that, when he's charging up for that multiple magic spell attack, he's open for a Light Arrow to the face. Saves magic, actually, so thanks, WiiKyle!

subject: Ganondorf
text: Striking Ganondorf with a Light Arrow after he is hit by a reflected spell lowers him to the ground where he can be slashed.

evidence.quote: Once he finally gets hit by a spell, quickly get the Light Arrows out and hit him with one before he recovers. Once he's hit, he'll lower to the ground. Quickly get to him and slash him before he gets back up.

subject: Morpha
text: To damage the boss, dodge its attack and Longshot the brain to snatch it away and start slashing it before it retreats back into its body.

evidence.quote: To damage the boss, dodge its attack and its brain will move around its body. Longshot the brain to snatch it away, and start slashing it. It'll then retreat back into its body.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Getting right on the central platform Ganondorf is hovering above leaves him no time to react once you reflect his spells, allowing shield stabs with the Biggoron's Sword or quick spin slashes once he's down.

evidence.quote: you can get right on the central platform Ganondorf is hovering above, leaving the 'dorf no time to react once you reflect his spells. Once he's down, either shield stab with the Biggoron's Sword or do quick spin slashes. (Rotate stick then immediately press B)
